author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದಾರಿದ್ರ್ಯ ಹಲವುಬಗೆ ಬಹುಜನರ ಕಾಡುವುದು
ತೋರುವುದು ಬಡತನವು ಗುಣ ನಡತೆ ಹಣದಿ
ಬೇರುಗಳ ಗಟ್ಟಿತನ ಬೇಗುದಿಯ ನೀಗುವುದು
ಸಾರಿಹವು ಉತ್ತರವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Poverty troubles many people in many forms;
it shows itself in virtue, in conduct and in money;
firm roots overcome the scorching heat;
they themselves proclaim the answer, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Poverty is not only about money; people can be poor in virtue and conduct too. Deep, firm roots of character carry us through the hardest heat.
